explanation: The Virginia opossum's act is involuntary, like fainting, and can last from minutes to hours. Drool and a foul-smelling fluid make it seem rotten to predators.

claims.text: Opossums, notably the Virginia opossum, play dead when threatened, going limp and releasing a foul-smelling fluid.
Raccoons, skunks and armadillos do not characteristically play dead when threatened.
An opossum's playing dead is an involuntary response that can last from minutes to hours.
While playing dead, an opossum may drool and release a foul-smelling fluid from its anal glands.
